title: Usage dashboard
empty: Turn on providers in settings. Add credentials in the Harness credential store; they are never kept in this repository.
needsDeepgramOptions: Deepgram also needs providerOptions.deepgram.projectId + balanceId — the key alone is not enough.
usageHint: Saved snapshots appear first. The server updates expired data, or you can force a refresh. There is no background polling.
updatingCache: Updating; showing the previous snapshot for now.
credHint: Enter a credential only when this store is writable. The value is never shown, logged, or written to this repository.
webHint: API keys live at the bottom under Credentials, or in Web Settings → Usage dashboard (Harness credential management). Usage numbers stay on top.
expHint: These providers stay unsupported until a free, read-only endpoint is confirmed. No request is sent for them.
providerHttpHint: The provider returned an HTTP error. Please try again later.
invalidResponseHint: The provider returned an invalid response that could not be read.
rejectedHint: The provider rejected the credential. Please check it and set it again.
notWritableHint: The credential store is read-only and cannot be written.
badRequestHint: The request was invalid. Please check your settings.
endpointHint: This usage endpoint is not allowed by the dashboard.
internalHint: The dashboard encountered an internal error. Please try again later.
unsupportedHint: A free, read-only usage endpoint has not been verified. No request was sent.
transportHint: The network connection failed. Please check your connection and try again.
insufficientHint: DeepSeek reports insufficient balance for API calls.
serverHint: Snapshots are saved on the DSH server and shared across devices; providers are queried only when data expires.
missingHint: Add a credential to view this provider’s usage.
modelsSource: Using the key from Models settings
timeoutHint: The provider timed out. You can try refreshing again.
staleHint: Refresh failed. Showing the last successful data.
sessionHint: This browser session has expired. Reopen DSH using its sign-in link.
forbiddenHint: DSH does not trust this address. Open the configured DSH address.
localSession: Connect a Codex usage source on the DSH server to view these limits.
settingsCaption: Enter credentials in the authenticated dashboard or Harness credential management. Only configuration status is shown here; secret values are never returned.
settingsHint: OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Deepgram and Tavily use API keys. Deepgram also requires projectId and balanceId. OpenCode Go usage support is experimental. Codex requires a server-side usage source. Kilo, Serper and Brave are not supported.
